openQuestions: The Blink runtime flag remains status experimental (ChromeOS) at trunk and on the M152 branch while the listing says 'Enabled by default'. The page attributes enablement for allowlisted IWAs to browser-process brokering (browser_process_read_write_access: true). Confirm with the integrator whether this framing is sufficient or whether a Chromium source pointer to the allowlist/enablement code should be added.

The chrome.app.window.setShape predecessor documentation no longer exists at developer.chrome.com (404). The API is named but unlinked; if a stable archive of the Chrome Apps reference exists it should be cited.

The setShape() spec resolves the promise after asking the host OS to apply the shape; whether OS-level application failure can still reject afterwards is not specified. The page describes the promise as resolving once the OS 'has been asked' - flag if a Chromium implementation read shows stronger guarantees.
The dual listing category ('Enabled by default' + 'Stepped rollout') is disclosed but not explained; the ChromeStatus record does not state why the feature appears in both.
